$comment: Brand logos served from public/logos/ (generated from the simple-icons npm package by `node scripts/gen-brand-logos.mjs`; never hot-linked from a CDN). slugs: every Simple Icons slug the site renders; brands Simple Icons does not ship (Slack, OpenAI) are left out and render as a monogram. tint: per-theme fill for brands whose default colour is invisible on one theme (hex without #); omitted themes keep the brand colour.
